program_or_activity: Risk Management Agency Federal Crop Insurance Corporation

component_decision.component: historical FY2020 disclosed policy-selection method and named payment-category coverage
component_decision.basis: The checksum-verified official FY2020 report expressly describes a simple random policy sample, all three named FCIC payment categories, statistically valid rate and dollar estimates, reinsurance year 2018, and OMB approval of the statistically valid methodology for FY2017 and beyond.

current_methodology_residuals: evidence that the FY2020 simple-random method continued through FY2024
current sample frame construction and coverage
current selection probabilities and randomization implementation
current replacement, nonresponse, and incomplete-document treatment
current exclusion rules below or outside the three named payment categories
evidence_boundaries: The closure is historical and applies only to the FY2020 disclosure tied to reinsurance year 2018.
The phrase FY2017 and beyond describes OMB approval in the FY2020 source; it is not evidence that the disclosed simple-random implementation remained unchanged through FY2024.
Naming all payment categories does not publish transaction-level inclusion and exclusion rules or prove that every current crop, policy, or payment entered the sampling frame.
Stating that rate and dollar estimates were statistically valid does not disclose the estimator, weights, projection formula, variance calculation, or confidence interval.
The cited disclosure appears in Other Information (Unaudited), which further limits it to a documented historical benchmark rather than independent validation of the method.
Nothing in the source establishes fraud, waste, identified debt, collectibility, recovery, prevention, control cost, or savings.
